امتعضنا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَعَضْنَا (imtaʕaḍnā) /im.ta.ʕadˤ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# اُمْتُعِضْنَا (umtuʕiḍnā) /um.tu.ʕidˤ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
